paper-2.$description: Recessed background, a shade darker than `surface` — no reference-site equivalent, derived to sit between `paper` and `surface`.

ink.$description: Primary text. 16.43:1 on paper, 14.85:1 on surface (AA+AAA) — the reference site's `--color-ink`.

muted.$description: Secondary text. 6.88:1 on paper, 6.22:1 on surface (AA) — the reference site's `--color-muted`.

soft.$description: Sublabels, boundary labels — no reference-site equivalent, derived between `muted` and `ink`.

rule-solid.$description: Container hairline. 2.03:1 on paper / 1.83:1 on surface — below WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1 by design (decorative, not interactive) — the reference site's `--color-edge`. Never on a focusable/interactive boundary; use `accent` there.

accent.$description: GRAPHIC colour only: fills, focus rings, interactive borders. 4.63:1 on paper (AA), 4.18:1 on surface (AA large-text/UI only) — the reference site's `--color-signal`. Never for text below 18px; use `link`.

link.$description: The accent TEXT colour, 9.64:1 on paper, 8.71:1 on surface — correct everywhere, no context check needed. The reference site's `--color-signal-light`.

accent-soft.$description: Tertiary — opt-in third tier, a paler step above `link`.

accent-dark.$description: Signal-tinted surface — the one background that deliberately breaks from `paper`/`surface` (the final CTA band). Same value in light and dark; it is always a dark accent band, not a themed one. The reference site's `--color-signal-dark`.

on-accent.$description: Text/icons on a filled `accent` surface — 4.63:1 (AA), since `ink`-on-`accent` is only 3.55:1 (fails AA normal text). The reference site's `--color-on-signal`.

on-fill.$description: Fixed white for text on `accent-dark`, the always-dark CTA band that never flips with the theme. Not for themed fills: text on `accent`/`danger` (filled buttons, the checkbox mark) uses `on-accent`, which is ground-coloured in dark.

danger.$description: Destructive or failed state. 8.98:1 on paper — re-verified against the new `#0B0E14` ground (2026-09-25 app-design review pass); value unchanged from the prior token set.

success.$description: Completed or valid state. 9.60:1 on paper — re-verified against the new `#0B0E14` ground (2026-09-25 app-design review pass); value unchanged from the prior token set.

warning.$description: Needs attention but not failed. 11.16:1 on paper — re-verified against the new `#0B0E14` ground (2026-09-25 app-design review pass); value unchanged from the prior token set.

disabled.$description: Inert control text and border. Deliberately low contrast (2.12) — WCAG exempts disabled controls.

focus-ring.$description: Focus indicator: 2px ink-on-paper ring, a standard focus-ring recipe — legible regardless of what's underneath, including a filled `accent` control. 16.43:1 on paper.

scrim.$description: Modal and drawer backdrop. Pure black on dark, since ink is near-white here.
